metadata.description: 20 anonymized real-life campus scheduling scenarios for evaluation

scenarios.description: 2 students arranging a study session for an upcoming midterm
scenarios.input:
Jason:
Monday 2-5pm free
Wednesday 1-4pm free
Flexibility: 6

Mei:
Monday 3-6pm free
Wednesday 1-3pm free
Flexibility: 7

ground_truth.notes: Monday overlap 15:00-17:00 and Wednesday overlap 13:00-15:00 both valid. Monday scored higher by ranking heuristic.

scenarios.description: 3 students for a group project meeting — one has evening-only constraint due to part-time job ending at 6pm
scenarios.input:
Alice:
Monday 2-4pm free
Tuesday 6-8pm free
Constraint: must be after 6pm
Flexibility: 3

Bob:
Monday 3-7pm free
Tuesday 3-7pm free
Flexibility: 8

Carol:
Monday 2-8pm free
Tuesday 5-8pm free
Flexibility: 6

ground_truth.notes: Alice's constraint eliminates all overlaps. Bob (flex 8) should be asked to shift. Tuesday 18:00-19:00 is Alice∩Bob∩Carol when constraint applied.

scenarios.description: 2 classmates — one can only do mornings, the other just barely overlaps in the midday gap

Thursday 9am-1pm free
Flexibility: 4

Ryan:
Thursday 12pm-5pm free
Flexibility: 7

ground_truth.notes: Raw overlap is 12:00-13:00 exactly (1 hour). No negotiation needed if 60-min min_duration is used — conflict checker should find it directly.

ground_truth.notes: Aisha∩Ben = 13:00-14:00. Carla starts at 15:00 so no 3-way overlap. Carla (flex 9) asked to shift start earlier. Post-acceptance slot = 13:00-14:00.

scenarios.description: Two students with mutually exclusive time constraints — one morning-only, one afternoon-only
scenarios.input:
Chris:
Monday 9am-12pm free
Tuesday 9am-12pm free
Constraint: must be before 12pm
Flexibility: 1

Jordan:
Monday 1pm-5pm free
Tuesday 2pm-6pm free
Constraint: must be after 1pm
Flexibility: 2

ground_truth.notes: Constraints are mutually exclusive. Both have very low flexibility so negotiation will fail. System should exhaust 3 rounds and report impossible.

scenarios.description: 3 students with no common available day at all across the week
scenarios.input:
Anna:
Monday 2-5pm free
Tuesday 10am-1pm free
Flexibility: 4

Bruno:
Wednesday 1-4pm free
Thursday 3-6pm free
Flexibility: 3

Clara:
Friday 10am-2pm free
Saturday 1-4pm free
Flexibility: 3

ground_truth.notes: Zero pairwise overlap across all days. All pairwise overlaps are empty. Negotiation cannot create overlap without actually changing days, which is beyond Phase 2 scope.

scenarios.description: All rigid participants with hard opposite constraints and no flexibility
scenarios.input:
Prof. Williams:
Friday 9am-11am free
Constraint: must be before 11am
Flexibility: 1

TA Marcus:
Friday 11am-1pm free
Constraint: must be after 11am
Flexibility: 1

Student Group:

Flexibility: 2

ground_truth.notes: Prof and TA have adjacent but non-overlapping constraint windows. Student Group could bridge 10-11 or 11-12 but not both simultaneously.

scenarios.description: Edge case: exactly 60-minute overlap — tests minimum duration boundary
scenarios.input:
Lisa:
Wednesday 1-4pm free
Flexibility: 5

Tom:
Wednesday 3-6pm free
Flexibility: 5

ground_truth.notes: Exactly 60-minute overlap at 15:00-16:00. Should pass min_duration_minutes=60 check. Edge case for boundary testing.

scenarios.description: Edge case: multiple equal-quality slots — tests ranking consistency
scenarios.input:
Amy:
Monday 2-4pm free
Tuesday 2-4pm free
Wednesday 2-4pm free
Flexibility: 6

Brian:
Monday 2-4pm free
Tuesday 2-4pm free
Wednesday 2-4pm free
Flexibility: 6

ground_truth.notes: All 3 days are identical. Ranking heuristic should prefer Tuesday (score 1.0) > Wednesday (score 1.0) > Monday (score 0.8) per day_preference dict.

scenarios.description: Complex real-world scenario: 3 students, mixed constraints, flexible member bridges gap
scenarios.input:
Wei:
Thursday 9am-12pm free
Constraint: must be before 12pm
Flexibility: 3

Sarah:
Thursday 11am-3pm free
Flexibility: 5

Mike:
Thursday 9am-3pm free
Flexibility: 9

ground_truth.notes: 3-way overlap 11:00-12:00 satisfies Wei's before-noon constraint. Mike is highly flexible but no negotiation needed — direct overlap exists.

evaluation_criteria.success_rate: Percentage of solvable scenarios (should_resolve=true) that produce a valid final_slot
evaluation_criteria.precision: Percentage of found slots that match ground_truth expected_slot
evaluation_criteria.negotiation_targeting_accuracy: When negotiation is required, was the correct target asked first
evaluation_criteria.impossible_detection_rate: Percentage of impossible scenarios correctly identified as unresolvable
evaluation_criteria.average_negotiation_rounds: Mean rounds used across all negotiable scenarios
evaluation_criteria.false_positive_rate: Percentage of impossible scenarios where system incorrectly claims success
